Sandbox_MinidoracatBuilder_Enabled_toolt: When off, the server refuses every build request from this mod. Things already built stay.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBuilder_WhoCanUse_too:
Everyone: every player can build.
Admins only: only players allowed to use the build cheat can build.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBuilder_WhereCanBuild:
Like vanilla: unclaimed land, and safehouses where the player may build.
Own safehouses only: only inside safehouses where the player may build.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBuilder_MaxDistance_t: 2 to 8 tiles from the player to the nearest square of the item. The item can be at most one floor above or below.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBuilder_MaxCellsPerDr: 1 to 64. How many items one build request can place, for example when dragging a line of walls.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBuilder_CostMultiplie: 0 to 10. Multiplies every material amount, rounded up. 0 means no materials; tools are still needed. Objects that dismantle into materials by their own material type (most furniture) never go below 1, so dismantling never gives back more than was paid. Admins with the build cheat on never pay.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBuilder_DisabledSourc: Mod IDs separated by semicolons. Tiles from these mods cannot be built. By default the Minidoracat family mods and mods whose tiles belong to their own build menus are off.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBuilder_DisabledTiles: Tileset names separated by semicolons, for example walls_exterior_house_01. Tiles from these tilesets cannot be built.
